items.title: Euro latest: Bellingham and Mbappe strike in Real Madrid win over Rayo Vallecano
Guimaraes haunts Sunderland as Arsenal continue winning start
items.description: Bruno Guimaraes scored a stunning goal two minutes after David Raya had saved a penalty as Arsenal beat Sunderland 2-0 to move above Manchester City at the top of the Premier League.

items.title: Arsenal hold off energetic Sunderland to continue perfect title defence
items.description: Arsenal maintain their 100% start to their Premier League season with a win at Sunderland, who mount an admirable push for a point before Bukayo Saka's penalty puts the result beyond doubt.

items.title: Arteta 'very worried & very sad' over penalty incident
items.description: Mikel Arteta is pleased with Arsenal's performance against Sunderland, but is "very worried and very sad" about the penalty awarded to their opponents during the match at the Stadium of Light.

items.title: Arsenal monitoring Como's Paz - Sunday's gossip
items.description: Arsenal are monitoring Nico Paz, Liverpool and Aston Villa are tracking Cher Ndour and Sunderland are refusing to give up on Geny Catamo, plus more.

items.title: Tottenham's wait for league goal continues after Everton draw
items.description: Tottenham's wait for a first Premier League goal and win this season continues after Roberto de Zerbi's side were held to a goalless home draw by Everton.

items.title: Fulham take first point of the season at lacklustre Liverpool
items.description: Fulham claim their first Premier League point of the season after a difficult start under Alvaro Arbeloa, as Liverpool fail to score for the first time this season just days after their Champions League victory over Atletico Madrid.

items.title: Flemming's late strike earns Ipswich win over 10-man Crystal Palace
items.description: Zian Flemming scores his first goal for Ipswich to give the club a late victory over 10-man Crystal Palace at Selhurst Park.

items.title: Brentford hold Bournemouth as Rose's wait for a win continues
items.description: Marco Rose's wait for a first Premier League victory as Bournemouth head coach continues as they are held to a 2-2 draw by Brentford at Vitality Stadium.

items.title: Jesus snatches late win for Forest as Villa's poor start continues
items.description: Igor Jesus scores an 88th minute winner as Nottingham Forest beat Aston Villa at Villa Park for the first time in 32 years and gives Oliver Glasner his first victory as Forest head coach since taking charge in the summer.

items.title: Hull remain unbeaten in league after impressive Chelsea draw
items.description: In-form striker Joao Pedro scores a second-half equaliser as Chelsea rescues a point at home to promoted Hull City.

items.title: Spurs latest: De Zerbi 'calm' over goalless start as he explains Tel exchange
